identity.location: Washington, DC metro chain scope; current official directory lists six District locations and additional Maryland/Virginia stores

sources.excerpt: Official Chopt Creative Salad Co. homepage and navigation.
Current official directory lists six Washington, DC stores: 1730 Penn, 19th & L, Archives, Ballpark, Chinatown, Metro Center, and Union Station.
Official Metro Center page confirms 618 12th St NW, Washington, DC 20005 and current pickup service.

Live chain menu publishes the Summer menu, high-protein picks, eight wraps including new Chicken Caesar and Mexicali Chicken Caesar, nine salads, four bowls, configurable meals, junior meals, drinks, snacks, and 18 to-go dressings.
Restaurant-controlled nutrition page links the core and seasonal guides and warns that cross-contact can occur and complete absence of allergens cannot be guaranteed.

Nine-page official guide marked UPDATED SPRING 2026 provides current standardized nutrition and positive columns for dairy, eggs, fish, shellfish, peanuts, tree nuts, sesame, soy, and gluten across composed items and components. It states salads and bowls exclude dressings from their rows.
Current official SUMMER MENU NUTRITION & ALLERGENS sheet covers Summer Corn Caesar Salad, Sweet Peach Burrata Bowl, six featured components, Basil Caesar, and Basil Vinaigrette.
Current Metro Center catering menu corroborates DC salads, wraps, sandwiches, components, packages, dressings, snacks, and beverages; it does not publish an independent allergen matrix.
Targeted searches surfaced the live official menu, nutrition page, Spring 2026 core guide, Summer guide, locations, and DC linked catering; no higher-authority current conflicting matrix was found.

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.summary: Chopt states cross-contact with other ingredients may occur and it cannot guarantee complete absence of allergens. This is retained at restaurant level and is not converted into universal item-level may-contain claims.

The core guide says salads and bowls do not include dressings in their nutrition or allergen rows; dressings remain separately represented products and their positives are not silently smeared onto configurable composed items.

findings.summary: The live Spring 2026 guide at the frozen URL exposes priority-allergen positives that the frozen extraction omitted, including dairy in multiple composed products, Pepper Jack, Pesto, Panko Fried Chicken and dressings. Current PDF coordinates were read against the labeled allergen columns; no contradictory current official source remains.

The live menu and separate Summer allergen sheet agree on Summer Corn Caesar Salad, Sweet Peach Burrata Bowl, featured components, and seasonal dressings. Summer Corn Caesar Wrap is live on the menu and uses the same disclosed seasonal components.
The restaurant issues a general cross-contact and no-guarantee statement but no product-specific cross-contact mapping. It remains restaurant-level; every item mayContainAllergens array stays empty.

proposedChanges: Publish 181 current products after consolidating 23 repeated base, generic, and name presentations; remove four legacy fountain beverages absent from all current complete surfaces.
Add nine current live-menu products: Chicken Caesar Wrap, Mexicali Chicken Caesar Wrap, Open Water Sparkling, two Kirra teas, Coke, Diet Coke, and two Spindrift waters.
Replace frozen allergen extraction with current Spring 2026 and Summer positive-column evidence, preserving official authority and seasonal scope.
Keep items without a current explicit positive allergen claim unavailable, even when a matrix row has no marked priority allergen; do not convert blank cells into supported absence claims.
Keep the restaurant-wide cross-contact warning separate from item-level may-contain arrays and retain the guide statement that salad and bowl rows exclude dressings.
